     Merges the 05c lineage-sensitivity draft with the depth-matched panel-vs-background test.
     Standalone: reads paired_L4.RData (02) and tables from 00c, 05, 05b; changes nothing upstream. -->

# Outline

Vent units are about 6x shallower than non-vent units (median retained expression ~177 k
vs ~1.0 M scaledTPM; `05_depth_check.csv`), vent-only allows plume but no
background detections (2026-11-23), and most vent-only features sit at the occupancy floor (05b: 78% of the 103
vent-only lineage-resolved KOs in 4–5 of 13 vent units). This script asks whether the
vent-only signature changes when depth, the occupancy bar, or the set of vent fields
changes, and whether the trophic-mode panel responds differently from the background.

1. **Check.** Unsubsampled calls reproduce 05 (KO classes) and 05b (pair classes).
2. **Depth x threshold.** Subsample units `N_DRAWS` times under three depth schemes, and
   classify at seven presence rules (20/30/40/50% of units, >= 3 (the 05 rule), >= 2, >= 1 unit).
3. **Panel vs background.** At each scheme x rule, the panel's vent-only fraction against
   all KOs, and against `N_NULL_SETS` random KO sets of the panel's size.
4. **Lineage headline (05b).** Vent-only lineage-resolved KOs, the share carried by
   lineages present in both habitats, and how many of the 05b vent-only pairs keep their class.
5. **Leave one vent field out.**

**Two levels, one classifier.** Community = KO; lineage = class-level taxon x KO pair.
Both use `classify_habitat()` (05/05b): vent-only = vent-associated and never detected in
background water (plume detections allowed, 2026-11-23); vent-skewed = vent-associated,
detected in background but below the non-vent bar. The 05 rule is >= 3 units per habitat.

**Depth schemes.**

* `none`: integer pseudo-counts, no subsampling (baseline for the draws).
* `nonvent_to_vent` (primary): each non-vent unit is subsampled to a depth drawn without
  replacement from the 13 vent unit depths; vent units are untouched, so the non-vent depth
  distribution matches the vent one.
* `common_vent_median`: units above the vent median depth are subsampled to it.
* `common_min`: all units subsampled to the shallowest unit (the 05 rarefied check). At
  that depth the per-million floor is < 1 read, so detection = >= 1 read, as in 05 and 05c.

_Expectation to state up front_: subsampling non-vent units can only remove non-vent
detections, so vent-only counts rise for every KO set by construction. The test is whether
the **panel** rises more than the background, not whether vent-only rises.

_Detection after subsampling_: the 05 rule (>= 1 count and >= 10 per million) on the
subsampled counts, per million of each unit's subsampled total. ScaledTPM is scaled to
library size (Soneson, Love & Robinson 2015, *F1000Research* 4:1521), so rounded values are
treated as pseudo-counts. Rarefying is the standard control for uneven effort when
presence/absence is compared (Schloss 2024, *mSphere* 9:e00354-23; Weiss et al. 2017,
*Microbiome* 5:27).

# Set up

```{r setup}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
source(if (file.exists("_setup.R")) "_setup.R" else "scripts/_setup.R")
```

```{r params}
FIELDS_IN_SCOPE <- c("Gorda Ridge", "Von Damm", "Piccard")
CHOSEN_DEPTH <- 4
MIN_TPM <- params$detect_min_tpm                 # 1
MIN_PER_MILLION <- params$detect_min_per_million # 10
OCC_SWEEP <- c(0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50)           # fraction rules
MIN_UNITS_SWEEP <- c(3, 2, 1)                    # fixed-count rules (as in 06)
# 05 rule (2026-11-23): >= 3 units in each habitat; vent-only tolerates plume detections
stopifnot(params$vent_min_units == params$nonvent_min_units)
REF_RULE <- paste0(">= ", params$vent_min_units, " unit(s)")
VENTONLY_TOLERATED <- params$ventonly_tolerated_tokens  # "Plume"

N_DRAWS <- 100      # subsampling draws per scheme (05 used 20)
N_NULL_SETS <- 999  # random KO sets for the panel null
SCHEMES <- c("none", "nonvent_to_vent", "common_vent_median", "common_min")
ROBUST <- 0.8       # vent-only in >= this share of draws = robust

PANEL_TABLE     <- "data/gene-lists/gene_candidates_central.csv" # 00c
KO_HAB_TABLE    <- "output-tables/05_ko_habitat_class.csv"       # 05
TAXON_TABLE     <- "output-tables/05_taxon_habitat.csv"          # 05
PAIR_HAB_TABLE  <- "output-tables/05b_taxon_ko_habitat.csv"      # 05b (classified pairs)
PAIR_DET_TABLE  <- "output-tables/05b_taxon_ko_pairs.csv.gz"     # 05b (all detected pairs)
```

```{r data}
#| message: true
paired <- load_paired(fields = FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, depth = CHOSEN_DEPTH)

units <- paired |>
  distinct(unit = sample_unit, vent_bin, field) |>
  arrange(vent_bin, field, unit)
n_units <- units |> count(vent_bin) |> deframe()   # Non-vent, Vent
stopifnot(n_units[["Vent"]] == 13, n_units[["Non-vent"]] == 6)

# taxon x KO per unit is the finest grain; KO totals are sums over it
pair_unit <- unit_expression(paired, c("cur_L4", "ko_id"), MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION)
ko_unit   <- unit_expression(paired, "ko_id", MIN_TPM, MIN_PER_MILLION)
rm(paired)

# KO-matched panel features (Pfam-only panel features are not tested here)
panel_kos <- read_csv(PANEL_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(!is.na(subcategory), status != "unresolved", match_type == "ko") |>
  distinct(feature_id) |>
  pull(feature_id) |>
  intersect(unique(ko_unit$ko_id))

ko_universe <- tibble(ko_id = sort(unique(ko_unit$ko_id)))

# lineage habitat class (05) and reference pair classes (05b), held fixed throughout
tax_hab   <- read_csv(TAXON_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(cur_L4, taxon_habitat = habitat_class)
ref_pairs <- read_csv(PAIR_HAB_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(cur_L4, ko_id, ref_class = habitat_class)
ref_vo    <- ref_pairs |> filter(ref_class == "vent_only")

message(glue("{nrow(ko_universe)} KOs ({length(panel_kos)} panel) | ",
             "{nrow(ref_vo)} vent-only lineage-resolved KOs in 05b"))
```

# Rules and classification

Each rule is written as unit counts per habitat, so every rule (and every leave-one-field-out
subset) goes through the same `classify_habitat()` used in 05 and 05b.

```{r rules}
min_count <- \(frac, n) ceiling(frac * n - 1e-9)

make_rules <- function(n_vent, n_nonvent) {
  bind_rows(
    tibble(rule = paste0(100 * OCC_SWEEP, "% of units"),
           vent_min = min_count(OCC_SWEEP, n_vent), nonvent_min = min_count(OCC_SWEEP, n_nonvent)),
    tibble(rule = paste0(">= ", MIN_UNITS_SWEEP, " unit(s)"),
           vent_min = MIN_UNITS_SWEEP, nonvent_min = MIN_UNITS_SWEEP)) |>
    mutate(rule = fct_inorder(rule))
}
rules <- make_rules(n_units[["Vent"]], n_units[["Non-vent"]])
rules

classify_counts <- function(n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, n_det_background, vent_min, nonvent_min) {
  classify_habitat(n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, n_det_background, vent_min, nonvent_min)
}

count_detections <- function(ue, by) {
  ue |>
    summarise(n_det_vent    = sum(detected & vent_bin == "Vent"),
              n_det_nonvent = sum(detected & vent_bin != "Vent"),
              n_det_background = sum(detected & vent_bin != "Vent" &
                                       !ventonly_tolerated(unit, vent_bin, VENTONLY_TOLERATED)),
              .by = all_of(by))
}
```

# 1. Check: unsubsampled calls reproduce 05 and 05b

```{r reproduce}
rule_30 <- filter(rules, rule == REF_RULE)   # the 05 rule (name kept from the 30% era)

obs_ko <- count_detections(ko_unit, "ko_id") |>
  mutate(habitat_class = classify_counts(n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, n_det_background,
                                         rule_30$vent_min, rule_30$nonvent_min))
check_05 <- read_csv(KO_HAB_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(ko_id, class_05 = habitat_class) |>
  full_join(obs_ko, by = "ko_id")

obs_pair <- count_detections(pair_unit, c("cur_L4", "ko_id")) |>
  filter(n_det_vent + n_det_nonvent > 0) |>
  mutate(habitat_class = classify_counts(n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, n_det_background,
                                         rule_30$vent_min, rule_30$nonvent_min))
check_05b_det <- read_csv(PAIR_DET_TABLE, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(cur_L4, ko_id, v05b = n_det_vent, n05b = n_det_nonvent) |>
  full_join(obs_pair, by = c("cur_L4", "ko_id"))
check_05b_cls <- ref_pairs |>
  left_join(obs_pair, by = c("cur_L4", "ko_id"))

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(check_05$class_05), !anyNA(check_05$habitat_class),
  all(as.character(check_05$habitat_class) == check_05$class_05),
  !anyNA(check_05b_det$v05b), !anyNA(check_05b_det$n_det_vent),
  all(check_05b_det$n_det_vent == check_05b_det$v05b),
  all(check_05b_det$n_det_nonvent == check_05b_det$n05b),
  all(as.character(check_05b_cls$habitat_class) == check_05b_cls$ref_class),
  sum(obs_pair$habitat_class == "vent_only") == nrow(ref_vo))
```

# 2. Subsampling

```{r subsample-setup}
# integer pseudo-counts at the pair grain
# >SKH: 2026-11-21 floor(), not round(): count >= 1 then equals 05's tpm >= 1, so the
# 'none' scheme reproduces 05b (round() let 0.5-1 TPM pairs through: 149 vs 103 vent-only)
pair_counts <- pair_unit |>
  transmute(unit, vent_bin, cur_L4, ko_id, count = as.integer(floor(tpm))) |>
  filter(count > 0)

unit_depth <- pair_counts |> summarise(depth = sum(count), .by = c(unit, vent_bin))
# 05's per-million denominator (all retained expression of the unit), per pseudo-count
unit_ref <- pair_unit |>
  distinct(unit, unit_total_05 = unit_total) |>
  left_join(select(unit_depth, unit, depth), by = "unit")
vent_depths <- unit_depth$depth[unit_depth$vent_bin == "Vent"]
unit_depth |>
  summarise(n = n(), min = min(depth), median = median(depth), max = max(depth), .by = vent_bin)

# draw without replacement from a unit's pseudo-counts (what vegan::rrarefy does per row)
subsample_counts <- function(counts, depth) {
  if (depth >= sum(counts)) return(counts)
  tabulate(sample(rep.int(seq_along(counts), counts), depth), nbins = length(counts))
}

draw_targets <- function(scheme) {
  d  <- mutate(unit_depth, target = depth)
  nv <- d$vent_bin != "Vent"
  if (scheme == "nonvent_to_vent")
    d$target[nv] <- pmin(d$depth[nv], sample(vent_depths, sum(nv)))
  if (scheme == "common_vent_median") d$target <- pmin(d$depth, round(median(vent_depths)))
  if (scheme == "common_min")         d$target <- pmin(d$depth, min(d$depth))
  d
}

subsample_table <- function(scheme) {
  if (scheme == "none") return(pair_counts)
  pair_counts |>
    left_join(select(draw_targets(scheme), unit, target), by = "unit") |>
    mutate(count = subsample_counts(count, first(target)), .by = unit) |>
    filter(count > 0) |>
    select(-target)
}

# 05's detection rule on (subsampled) counts. >SKH: 2026-11-21 the per-million
# denominator is 05's unit total scaled by the share of pseudo-counts kept, not the sum of
# pair counts (which omits expression outside the pair table and loosened the floor)
detect_counts <- function(sub, by) {
  kept <- sub |>
    summarise(unit_total = sum(count), .by = unit) |>
    left_join(unit_ref, by = "unit") |>
    mutate(denom = unit_total_05 * unit_total / depth) |>
    select(unit, unit_total, denom)
  sub |>
    summarise(count = sum(count), .by = all_of(c("unit", "vent_bin", by))) |>
    left_join(kept, by = "unit") |>
    mutate(detected = count >= MIN_TPM & count / denom * 1e6 >= MIN_PER_MILLION) |>
    select(-denom)
}
```

Random KO sets for the null, fixed once and reused in every draw, drawn from non-panel KOs.

```{r null-sets}
set.seed(params$seed)
pool_idx <- which(!ko_universe$ko_id %in% panel_kos)
null_sets <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
  i = rep(seq_len(N_NULL_SETS), each = length(panel_kos)),
  j = unlist(map(seq_len(N_NULL_SETS), \(s) sample(pool_idx, length(panel_kos)))),
  x = 1, dims = c(N_NULL_SETS, nrow(ko_universe)))
```

```{r tally-functions}
# classify KOs and pairs under one rule; per-KO tallies for the set summaries
classify_rule <- function(ko_det, pair_det, vent_min, nonvent_min) {
  ko <- ko_universe |>
    left_join(ko_det, by = "ko_id") |>
    replace_na(list(n_det_vent = 0L, n_det_nonvent = 0L, n_det_background = 0L)) |>
    mutate(class = classify_counts(n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, n_det_background, vent_min, nonvent_min))
  pair <- pair_det |>
    mutate(class = classify_counts(n_det_vent, n_det_nonvent, n_det_background, vent_min, nonvent_min)) |>
    filter(class != "below_filter")
  per_ko <- ko |>
    transmute(ko_id,
              c_vo = as.numeric(class == "vent_only"),
              c_va = as.numeric(class %in% c("vent_only", "vent_skewed")),
              c_n  = as.numeric(class != "below_filter")) |>
    left_join(pair |> summarise(l_vo = sum(class == "vent_only"), l_n = n(), .by = ko_id),
              by = "ko_id") |>
    replace_na(list(l_vo = 0, l_n = 0))
  list(per_ko = per_ko, pair_vo = filter(pair, class == "vent_only") |> select(cur_L4, ko_id))
}

# panel, background (all KOs) and null fractions at each level
set_summary <- function(per_ko) {
  is_panel <- per_ko$ko_id %in% panel_kos
  levels <- list(community_vent_only  = c("c_vo", "c_n"),
                 community_vent_assoc = c("c_va", "c_n"),
                 lineage_vent_only    = c("l_vo", "l_n"))
  map_dfr(levels, \(cols) {
    num <- per_ko[[cols[1]]]
    den <- per_ko[[cols[2]]]
    frac_panel <- sum(num[is_panel]) / sum(den[is_panel])
    null_frac  <- as.vector(null_sets %*% num) / as.vector(null_sets %*% den)
    tibble(n_panel = sum(num[is_panel]), d_panel = sum(den[is_panel]), frac_panel,
           n_bg = sum(num), d_bg = sum(den), frac_bg = sum(num) / sum(den),
           null_median = median(null_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
           null_pctile = mean(null_frac <= frac_panel, na.rm = TRUE))
  }, .id = "level")
}

# 05b headline for one set of vent-only pairs (count-based; tpm_vent optional)
lineage_headline <- function(pair_vo) {
  vo <- pair_vo |>
    left_join(tax_hab, by = "cur_L4") |>
    left_join(ref_pairs, by = c("cur_L4", "ko_id"))
  tibble(n_vent_only = nrow(vo),
         n_vent_only_panel = sum(vo$ko_id %in% panel_kos),
         frac_on_shared_lineages = mean(vo$taxon_habitat %in% "shared"),
         expr_on_shared_lineages = if ("tpm_vent" %in% names(vo))
           sum(vo$tpm_vent[vo$taxon_habitat %in% "shared"]) / sum(vo$tpm_vent) else NA_real_,
         n_kept_from_05b = sum(vo$ref_class %in% "vent_only"))
}

# everything for one table of detections, at every rule
evaluate <- function(ko_det, pair_det, rules, pair_tpm = NULL) {
  pmap(rules, \(rule, vent_min, nonvent_min) {
    cl <- classify_rule(ko_det, pair_det, vent_min, nonvent_min)
    pv <- if (is.null(pair_tpm)) cl$pair_vo else left_join(cl$pair_vo, pair_tpm, by = c("cur_L4", "ko_id"))
    list(summary   = set_summary(cl$per_ko) |> mutate(rule = rule, .before = 1),
         headline  = lineage_headline(pv) |> mutate(rule = rule, .before = 1),
         vent_only = tibble(rule = rule, ko_id = cl$per_ko$ko_id[cl$per_ko$c_vo == 1]))
  }) |>
    list_transpose() |>
    map(bind_rows)
}
```

```{r run-draws}
#| message: true
runs <- expand_grid(scheme = SCHEMES, draw = seq_len(N_DRAWS)) |>
  filter(scheme != "none" | draw == 1)

set.seed(params$seed)
t0 <- Sys.time()
results <- pmap(runs, \(scheme, draw) {
  sub      <- subsample_table(scheme)
  ko_ue    <- detect_counts(sub, "ko_id")
  pair_det <- detect_counts(sub, c("cur_L4", "ko_id")) |> count_detections(c("cur_L4", "ko_id"))
  out <- evaluate(count_detections(ko_ue, "ko_id"), pair_det, rules)
  out$depth <- ko_ue |>
    summarise(depth = first(unit_total), ko_detected = sum(detected), .by = c(unit, vent_bin))
  map(out, \(x) mutate(x, scheme = scheme, draw = draw, .before = 1))
})
message(glue("{nrow(runs)} draws in {round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = 'mins'), 1)} min"))

results   <- results |> list_transpose() |> map(bind_rows)
draws     <- results$summary  |> mutate(scheme = factor(scheme, levels = SCHEMES))
headlines <- results$headline |> mutate(scheme = factor(scheme, levels = SCHEMES))
```

## Did subsampling match depth?

If non-vent units still detect more KOs at matched depth, the richness gap is not a depth
artifact.

```{r depth-diagnostic}
depth_summary <- results$depth |>
  summarise(median_depth = median(depth), median_ko_detected = median(ko_detected),
            .by = c(scheme, draw, vent_bin)) |>
  summarise(across(c(median_depth, median_ko_detected), median), .by = c(scheme, vent_bin)) |>
  arrange(factor(scheme, levels = SCHEMES), vent_bin)
depth_summary
```

# 3. Panel vs background across depth and threshold

```{r sweep-summary}
q <- \(x, p) unname(quantile(x, p, na.rm = TRUE))

sweep_summary <- draws |>
  mutate(diff = frac_panel - frac_bg) |>
  summarise(across(c(n_panel, frac_panel, n_bg, frac_bg, diff, null_pctile),
                   list(med = median, lo = \(x) q(x, 0.025), hi = \(x) q(x, 0.975))),
            .by = c(scheme, rule, level))

sweep_summary |>
  select(level, scheme, rule, n_panel_med, frac_panel_med, frac_bg_med,
         diff_lo, diff_hi, null_pctile_med) |>
  arrange(level, scheme, rule)
```

> For results: a panel-specific vent signal would show as a `diff` interval that excludes 0
> and a null percentile above 0.975 under `nonvent_to_vent`. A rise in both panel and
> background with overlapping intervals means depth affects all KOs alike.

```{r fig-sweep}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
plot_df <- sweep_summary |>
  select(scheme, rule, level, starts_with("frac_")) |>
  pivot_longer(starts_with("frac_"), names_to = c("set", ".value"),
               names_pattern = "frac_(panel|bg)_(med|lo|hi)") |>
  mutate(set = recode(set, panel = "Trophic-mode panel", bg = "All KOs"),
         level = recode(level, community_vent_only = "Community: vent-only",
                        community_vent_assoc = "Community: vent-only + vent-skewed",
                        lineage_vent_only = "Lineage: vent-only pairs"))

fig_sweep <- plot_df |>
  ggplot(aes(rule, 100 * med, colour = set)) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(ymin = 100 * lo, ymax = 100 * hi),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.25) +
  facet_grid(level ~ scheme, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Trophic-mode panel" = "#b74a70", "All KOs" = "grey40"),
                      name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Presence rule", y = "% of classified KOs / pairs") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "bottom")
fig_sweep
# ggsave("figures/08-ventonly-sensitivity.svg", fig_sweep, width = 10, height = 6)
```

# 4. Lineage headline (05b) across depth and threshold

`frac_on_shared_lineages` = share of vent-only lineage-resolved KOs carried by lineages
present in both habitats (05 lineage class "shared", held fixed). Expression share is
reported only without subsampling (section 5), since subsampled counts are not expression.

```{r lineage-headline}
headline_summary <- headlines |>
  summarise(across(c(n_vent_only, n_vent_only_panel, frac_on_shared_lineages, n_kept_from_05b),
                   list(med = median, lo = \(x) q(x, 0.025), hi = \(x) q(x, 0.975))),
            .by = c(scheme, rule)) |>
  arrange(scheme, rule)
headline_summary |>
  select(scheme, rule, n_vent_only_med, n_vent_only_lo, n_vent_only_hi,
         frac_on_shared_lineages_med, n_kept_from_05b_med)
```

## Which vent-only KOs hold up

Share of `nonvent_to_vent` draws in which each KO is vent-only (community level), by rule,
next to its 05 class.

```{r ko-stability}
ko_stability <- results$vent_only |>
  filter(scheme == "nonvent_to_vent") |>
  count(rule, ko_id, name = "n_draws") |>
  mutate(share_draws = n_draws / N_DRAWS) |>
  left_join(select(obs_ko, ko_id, class_05 = habitat_class), by = "ko_id") |>
  mutate(panel = ko_id %in% panel_kos) |>
  arrange(rule, desc(share_draws))

ko_stability |>
  filter(share_draws >= ROBUST) |>
  count(rule, class_05, panel)
```

> For results: of the 31 05 vent-only KOs, how many stay vent-only at matched depth, and
> how many KOs become vent-only only after depth matching (and whether they are panel KOs).

# 5. Leave one vent field out

Drops one field's vent units; non-vent units are kept. Fraction rules are recomputed on the
remaining vent units (Von Damm 7, Gorda Ridge 4, Piccard 2 vent units). Unsubsampled, so
expression share is defined here.

```{r field-drop}
#| message: true
units |> count(field, vent_bin)

field_drop <- map(FIELDS_IN_SCOPE, \(fld) {
  keep <- units |> filter(!(vent_bin == "Vent" & field == fld))
  ko_ue   <- ko_unit   |> filter(unit %in% keep$unit)
  pair_ue <- pair_unit |> filter(unit %in% keep$unit)
  pair_tpm <- pair_ue |> filter(vent_bin == "Vent") |>
    summarise(tpm_vent = sum(tpm), .by = c(cur_L4, ko_id))
  out <- evaluate(count_detections(ko_ue, "ko_id"),
                  count_detections(pair_ue, c("cur_L4", "ko_id")),
                  make_rules(sum(keep$vent_bin == "Vent"), sum(keep$vent_bin != "Vent")),
                  pair_tpm = pair_tpm)
  map(out[c("summary", "headline")], \(x)
      mutate(x, dropped = fld, n_vent_units = sum(keep$vent_bin == "Vent"), .before = 1))
}) |>
  list_transpose() |>
  map(bind_rows)

field_drop$headline |> filter(rule == REF_RULE)
field_drop$summary  |> filter(rule == REF_RULE) |>
  select(dropped, n_vent_units, level, n_panel, frac_panel, frac_bg, null_pctile)
```

# Write

# QC

```{r qc}
full_depth <- rename(unit_depth, depth_full = depth)
stopifnot(
  # vent units are never subsampled under the primary scheme
  results$depth |> filter(scheme == "nonvent_to_vent", vent_bin == "Vent") |>
    left_join(full_depth, by = c("unit", "vent_bin")) |> with(all(depth == depth_full)),
  # no subsampled unit is deeper than it started
  results$depth |> left_join(full_depth, by = c("unit", "vent_bin")) |>
    with(all(depth <= depth_full)),
  # one 'none' run, N_DRAWS of each other scheme
  all(count(distinct(draws, scheme, draw), scheme)$n == c(1, rep(N_DRAWS, length(SCHEMES) - 1))),
  # the 'none' run at the 05 rule gives the 05b headline (flooring can move a few pairs at
  # the per-million floor)
  with(filter(headlines, scheme == "none", rule == REF_RULE),
       abs(n_vent_only - nrow(ref_vo)) <= 5 & n_kept_from_05b >= nrow(ref_vo) - 5),
  all(between(draws$frac_panel, 0, 1), between(draws$frac_bg, 0, 1)))
```
